description: This file defines the ProxyGrain class, which implements the IProxyGrain interface and extends the Grain class. It manages a proxy for ITestGrain, providing methods to create the proxy and retrieve runtime identifiers.

classes.name: ProxyGrain
classes.description: A grain class that acts as a proxy for ITestGrain, providing methods to create the proxy and retrieve runtime IDs.

methods.name: CreateProxy
methods.description: Initializes the proxy grain with a specified key.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of this grain instance.

methods.name: GetProxyRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime ID of the proxied grain.
